artifact_contract.oversize_policy: fail build and preserve the last valid latest; never truncate

availability_state_contract.confirmed_false: the source fact explicitly observed boolean false
availability_state_contract.confirmed_true: the source fact explicitly observed boolean true
availability_state_contract.confirmed_value: the source fact explicitly observed a non-boolean value
availability_state_contract.not_ready: required source module is missing, stale, or not entitled and no security-level value is observed
availability_state_contract.unknown: source module is ready or partial but this security-level value is not known; unknown is never false

candidate_union_metadata.screen_count_semantics: raw count of deterministic filters that captured the security
candidate_union_metadata.union_order_semantics: deterministic transport order only; not a relative attractiveness ordering and no subjective weighting is applied

contradiction_flag_definitions.high_turnover: turnover_ratio is at or above the daily 95th percentile
contradiction_flag_definitions.volume_spike_but_negative_return: change_ratio < 0 and either amount_change_pct or turnover_change_pct is positive

cross_sectional_features.amount_rank: descending amount; rank 1 is the highest amount
cross_sectional_features.amount_to_float_market_cap: amount divided by float_market_cap when both are observed and float_market_cap > 0
cross_sectional_features.percentile_method: daily cross-section, average rank for ties, ascending values, range (0, 1]
cross_sectional_features.turnover_rank: descending turnover_ratio; rank 1 is the highest turnover_ratio

board_neutral_absolute_move__bse.definition: board == BSE and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

board_neutral_absolute_move__chinext.definition: board == CHINEXT and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

board_neutral_absolute_move__sse_main.definition: board == SSE_MAIN and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

board_neutral_absolute_move__star.definition: board == STAR and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

board_neutral_absolute_move__szse_main.definition: board == SZSE_MAIN and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

large_negative_weak_close.definition: negative bottom-quintile 1D return and close_location < 0.2; confirmation percentile descending

large_positive_strong_close.definition: positive top-quintile 1D return and close_location >= 0.8; confirmation percentile descending

large_positive_weak_close.definition: positive top-quintile 1D return and close_location < 0.4; confirmation percentile descending

market_cap_neutral_absolute_move__mega_g.definition: market_cap_bucket == mega_ge_300bn_cny and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

market_cap_neutral_absolute_move__micro_.definition: market_cap_bucket == micro_lt_5bn_cny and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

market_cap_neutral_absolute_move__mid_20.definition: market_cap_bucket == mid_20_to_80bn_cny and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

market_cap_neutral_absolute_move__small_.definition: market_cap_bucket == small_5_to_20bn_cny and absolute raw_return_1d_pct > 0; absolute move descending

momentum_acceleration_1d_vs_3d_5d.definition: 1D return exceeds both dailyized 3D and dailyized 5D trends; difference descending

positive_momentum_1d_3d_5d.definition: raw_return_1d_pct > 0, raw_return_3d_pct > 0, and raw_return_5d_pct > 0; weakest horizon percentile descending

price_down_activity_contraction.definition: change_ratio < 0, amount_change_pct < 0, and turnover_change_pct < 0; contraction confirmation descending

price_down_activity_expansion.definition: change_ratio < 0, amount_change_pct > 0, and turnover_change_pct > 0; confirmation percentile descending

price_up_activity_contraction.definition: change_ratio > 0, amount_change_pct < 0, and turnover_change_pct < 0; contraction confirmation descending

price_up_activity_expansion.definition: change_ratio > 0, amount_change_pct > 0, and turnover_change_pct > 0; confirmation percentile descending

weak_5d_positive_1d_reversal.definition: return_5d_pctile <= 0.2, return_1d_pctile >= 0.8, and raw_return_1d_pct > 0; confirmation descending
